name: record_id
label: Record identifier
description: Unique identifier of the record; no meaning

name: hhid
label: Household identifier
description: Identifier of the household the person belongs to; records of one household must stay in one split

name: region
label: Region
description: Region of residence: R01 Northern, R02 Central, R03 Southern, R04 Eastern

name: educ
label: Education level
description: ISCED 2011 level 0 to 5 (6 and above collapsed into 5)

name: job_title
label: Job description
description: The respondent's description of their main job, as recorded by the interviewer

name: industry_text
label: Industry description
description: The respondent's description of the activity of the establishment

name: isco_code
label: Occupation code
description: ISCO-08 unit group (four digits) assigned by a trained coder; the label to predict

name: isco_major
label: Occupation major group
description: First digit of isco_code; a coarser label

name: weight
label: Survey weight
description: Person weight calibrated to the population; use for population estimates, never as a training sample weight without a stated reason
